span.p:
Atlas L1 (per-cluster aggregator)
- Cross-instance aggregation
- Sends to Atlas L2 every 60 seconds

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Atlas L2 (global aggregator)
- Global view of all metrics
- Full resolution for 2 weeks
- Downsampled for 1 year
- Serves dashboards + alerts

span.p:
Atlas Agent (per instance)
- Aggregates metrics locally for 60 seconds
- Sends to Atlas L1 every 60 seconds
- Deduplicates on retransmit

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
Key insight: Atlas uses a two-tier aggregation model.
L1 aggregates within a cluster, L2 across clusters.
This reduces global write load by 60:1.
